about: What Oracle sends for a table pre-check's figures at each level, and for its duplicate keys: the plain and mapped sides of oracle_pair.json (a composite key, a prefix_pad key map, a filter, a typeMap column, a float, large-object, bytes and moment columns). Regenerate only with a contract change.

counts: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(t."ID", 'TM9') IS NULL THEN 1 END) FROM "APP"."CUSTOMERS" t
columns: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(t."ID", 'TM9') IS NULL THEN 1 END), COUNT(CASE WHEN t."EMAIL" IS NULL THEN 1 END), COUNT(CASE WHEN LENGTH4(t."EMAIL") = 0 THEN 1 END), MIN(LENGTH4(t."EMAIL")), MAX(LENGTH4(t."EMAIL")), COUNT(CASE WHEN t."AMOUNT" IS NULL THEN 1 END), TO_CHAR(SUM(t."AMOUNT"), 'TM9'), TO_CHAR(MIN(t."AMOUNT"), 'TM9'), TO_CHAR(MAX(t."AMOUNT"), 'TM9') FROM "APP"."CUSTOMERS" t
distinct: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t."EMAIL"), COUNT(DISTINCT t."AMOUNT") FROM "APP"."CUSTOMERS" t
duplicates: SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(d.n), 0) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "APP"."CUSTOMERS" t WHERE TO_CHAR(t."ID", 'TM9') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TO_CHAR(t."ID", 'TM9') HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) d
